entities.name: Geographic Information Systems (GIS) for History
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The application of geospatial technology to historical research, enabling scholars to map and analyze spatial patterns in historical data. From reconstructing ancient trade routes to mapping plague spread and demographic shifts, historical GIS has created a new field of spatial history that reveals patterns invisible in traditional text-based sources.
